captions.detailed: A Gothic-style stone belfry tower featuring a square base, an open upper chamber with arched openings, and a dark grey octagonal pointed spire on top of a circular ribbed drum. Inside the open belfry, two large bronze-colored bells are hung from dark timber yokes on separate horizontal shafts. Each bell is designed to swing on a revolute joint, and each has an internal metal clapper that can swing independently on a secondary pin.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a Gothic stone belfry tower with a pointed octagonal spire. Inside the open belfry chamber, mount two bronze bells on timber yokes using horizontal revolute joints, and include an internal clapper for each bell on its own secondary revolute joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-story square stone tower using box primitives, adding arches and corner pillars to form the open belfry chamber. A cylindrical drum is placed on top, surmounted by a lofted or extruded octagonal cone to form the pointed spire. Inside the chamber, a wooden crossbeam holds two separate bell sub-assemblies. Each bell is modeled by lofting concentric circles of varying radii, attached to a timber yoke (box), and connected to the tower via a revolute joint. Inside each bell, a clapper (modeled with a sphere and cylinder) is attached to the yoke with a secondary revolute joint.
